inventory.visualPurpose: Cell cycle phase map with cyclin-CDK, p53 and Rb checkpoints
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Circular G1→S→G2→M diagram with restriction point and G2/M checkpoint, cyclin-CDK pairs, Rb-E2F gate, p53-p21 arrest axis

notes: Original KYP redraw of the cell-cycle circle: interphase G1/S/G2 with G0 outside, the G1 restriction point labeled with the source's own words (Rb, p53 modulate), cyclin-CDK → Rb P → E2F release → gene transcription, the p53 → p21 → CDK inhibition arm, the BCL-2/BCL-XL → BAX/BAK → caspase apoptosis branch, and the HPV E6 and Li-Fraumeni annotations on the p53 node.
